breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the vertical stems at x=0.3 and x=0.5 should have u_x=0 (normal condition) imposed. The ground truth specifies u_y=0 (tangential/vertical condition) on those stems, consistent with the original case details. The generated specification correctly states 'The vertical boundary segments at x=0.3 (for 0.1 ≤ y ≤ 0.2) and x=0.5 (for 0.1 ≤ y ≤ 0.2) have their vertical displacement constrained to zero (u_y = 0)', matching the ground truth and resolving the inconsistency.
